description: Levee setback distance analysis of groundwater recharge input and output is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Calderwood, Andrew (deposited on HydroShare). The data included here are part of a larger research project on the lower Cosumnes River, southeast of Sacramento, CA, USA. This part of the research focused on the impact of geologic heterogeneity on groudnwater recharge under hypothetical levee setbacks. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2024-04-20 and last updated 2024-04-21; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
